data.title: bn-1ugh: order-independent SQLite projection via per-field winner keys

data.reason: BLOCK: v3 upgrade path skips the forced rebuild. Many write commands (assign.rs:196, delete.rs:259, also close/archive/dep/reopen/undo/unstart) call db::open_projection directly: migrate() clears the cursor, then Projector::project_event -> update_cursor_to_event_log_end (project.rs:156,295) writes cursor = log end + this event hash. ensure_projection then sees no drift, so the full rebuild never runs and field_clocks stays empty for all pre-v3 state. Scenario: upgrade, run 'bn assign bn-x alice' first, then git pull a concurrent branch with an OLDER title update: claim() finds no row, returns true, older title overwrites newer one; a replica that did rebuild keeps the newer one -> permanent divergence (the exact bug this fixes). Also claim_reset cannot see pre-v3 labels/links (no rows), so legacy label-array replace and link removal without a type leave stale members (regression vs old DELETE-all). Fix: do not advance a cleared cursor (offset 0/hash NULL) in update_cursor_to_event_log_end, or write the dirty marker / a needs_rebuild flag in the v3 migration and honor it in projection_needs_rebuild; add a test: v2 DB -> open_projection -> project_event -> ensure_projection must rebuild. Non-blocking: (1) claim uses strict >, so re-projecting an event after a partial apply (project_event has no txn) never rewrites the field; use >= or a SAVEPOINT per event. (2) claim_reset substr uses byte len (prefix.len()) vs SQLite char len; non-ASCII or slash-containing link targets alias/miss; use a range or instr. (3) create now does ~8 items UPDATEs, each firing items_au FTS reindex on the single-event path; batch into one UPDATE. (4) Test never generates create-after-update, parent, compact, snapshot, redact; snapshot omits parent_id, deleted_at_us, compact_summary. (5) Title/description redact order-dependence is pre-existing. Core claim/reset logic and SQL upsert semantics look correct.

Re-review b7af8d17+b0ca7985: blocking finding fixed. open_projection reads user_version before migrate and writes the dirty marker for existing pre-v3 DBs, so a write-first upgrade still forces a full rebuild; regression test covers the exact scenario. claim_reset prefix now uses SQLite length(), which fixes the byte/char mismatch. prepare_cached is safe (set_field columns are fixed literals). cargo test -p bones-core passes. Non-blocking: a process kill between migrate commit and marker write loses the marker (the cleared cursor still covers most paths; writing the marker before migrate would close it); a kill mid project_event is not covered by the error-path dirty marker, so claim with strict > can keep a stale field until the next full rebuild; targets containing a slash can still alias link keys (item IDs make this unlikely).
Re-LGTM at HEAD: reviewer LGTM on b0ca7985 plus two small crash-safety fixes from its non-blocking notes (marker before migrate, savepoint per project_event). Workspace tests pass.
LGTM at HEAD 2cd10ffd: subagent reviewer approved through b0ca7985; 2cd10ffd adds only the two crash-safety fixes from its non-blocking notes. Workspace tests pass.
